Penalties are caps set after an enquiry, never an automatic amount per photo, and the main provisions are scheduled to take effect on 13 May 2027. In priority order by cap: failing to keep reasonable security safeguards (up to ₹250 crore), failing to notify a breach (up to ₹200 crore), and breaching children’s-data duties (up to ₹200 crore). Other duties carry lower caps. Counsel should advise on your school’s position.
